The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: A rectangular prism, with a length of 5 blocks, width of 4 blocks, and height of 3 blocks. There is a hole shown on the top of the rectangular prism. The hole is 2 blocks by 3 blocks and goes all the way through the shape.]

The figure above shows a shape made up of cubes that are all the same size. There is a hole all the way through the shape. How many cubes would be needed to fill the hole?

Figure, described in words:
An isometric drawing of a 3D block shape constructed from identical unit cubes. The overall block is 5 cubes wide along the front, 4 cubes deep along the right side, and 3 cubes tall. In the center of the top face, there is a rectangular rectangular hole measuring 3 cubes wide by 2 cubes deep, bordered by a rim that is 1 cube wide on all four sides. The hole extends vertically straight down through the entire height of 3 cubes.

A. 6
B. 12
C. 15
D. 18

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
